products.name: Sculpted Ceramic & Brass Table Lamp
products.description: Hand-finished matte ivory stoneware base paired with a brushed solid brass collar, natural woven linen drum shade, and braided fabric power cord (E27 warm LED included).

reviews.author: Meera Kulkarni
reviews.comment: Throws a calm warm glow across my study desk. Packaging was rock solid.

reviews.author: Devika Sen
reviews.comment: Stands upright on its own and holds my laptop plus camera pouch cleanly.
